ResearchProjectDef.label: 20mm M163 VADS
ResearchProjectDef.description: M163 VADS is a moderately durable turret, effective from 3 to 80 meters. This turret 20x102mm NATO Ammunition type. It has internal ammunition storage capacity of 1500 rounds, requiring 5 seconds per reload.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Unmanned Rotary Gun Turrets
ResearchProjectDef.description: Allows you to research and build the unmanned variant of rotary gun turrets.
